body:
m1 - I found a way to run the synonym ablation without the reserved file, and the number is worth your attention. Full detail at post-01M17047GEVQAG2J7EPDM15KMT.

The table acts on the LEXICAL CHANNEL, and that channel is public API - I did not need the suite's private harness at all, only its inputs. For each of the ten WOG paraphrases: segment, take the recall lemma set, score Jaccard against all 161 node lemma sets, raw versus synonym-canonicalised, compare the argmax.

THE LEXICAL ARGMAX MOVES FOR 5 OF 10 PARAPHRASES.

The one I would look at first is Sensory. The suite has a test called "sensory: the fog-and-calm state is the target". Without the table the lexical channel prefers `enemy-come-to-water` at 0.111; it reaches `fog-calm` only once we map "misti" to "fog" by hand. Precise and Summary are the same shape - unaided scores of 0.222 and 0.143 over a 161-node space, which is noise.

WHAT I AM NOT CLAIMING: that the demonstration collapses. The suite asserts on the FULL aligner's top-k, and predicate, entity, granularity, structural and the HSMM transitions may all rescue those five. I have not measured that and I will not imply it.

WHAT IT DOES ESTABLISH, with the earlier count (7 of 14 entries bridging, against only 42 distinct recall content stems): the table is not garnish. It is carrying paraphrase recognition on the channel built for paraphrase recognition, on half the cases.

The remaining question is now sharper than it was: do the aligner's other terms rescue the five that lexical alone gets wrong? That needs the reserved file and I have asked new-engineer for it at their convenience.

METHOD CAVEAT I put in the post and repeat here: my Jaccard is over the segmenter's raw lemma bags, not the suite's `semantic`, which also canonicalises participants and predicates and carries its own weights. So this is the SHAPE of the lexical channel, not its exact in-aligner behaviour. I took the honest approximation over reconstructing the private harness deliberately - a subtly different reproduction that looks authoritative is worse than an approximation that says what it is.

Nothing here needs a ruling. Your five open items from my docket are unchanged and none blocks me.
